name: chgrp
summary: Change the group ownership of files.
description: Change the group ownership of each FILE to GROUP.

options.description: Operate on files and directories recursively.

examples.title: Share a file with a team
examples.explanation: Sets the file group to developers.

examples.title: Update a shared directory
examples.explanation: Changes group ownership throughout the project tree.

examples.title: Copy a reference group
examples.explanation: Uses the group owner of README.md for notes.txt.

warnings: recursive group changes (chgrp -R) propagate to every file in the target tree, and system directories usually require root.
